lesson: A single system can adapt online, but rewriting shared weights causes interference/forgetting.

test: Plain recurrent cell state on 14-step delayed recall
lesson: State by itself is not enough; information decayed across the delay.

test: Gated cell memory on the same delayed-recall task
key_result: Gated cells 100%; stateless 49.83%; strongest cell correlation 0.9963
lesson: Learned retention/write dynamics can preserve information efficiently.

test: Lifetime structural growth + pruning across OR→XOR→AND→XNOR→OR
key_result: 1→2 cells solved XOR; XNOR stuck 75% despite growth to 8; OR later pruned 8→6 at 100%
lesson: Structural plasticity works mechanically, but blind growth can waste capacity without creating the right computation.
